name: claude-usage
description: All your ccswitch accounts in the sidebar: 5h/weekly usage, most headroom, one-click switch, auto-switch

commands.title: Claude Usage: Toggle auto-switch to most headroom

claudeUsage.autoSwitch.markdownDescription: When the active account reaches 100% (5h or weekly), switch Claude Code to the next-best account via ccswitch, **without asking**. It applies to every new Claude Code session on this machine; open tabs keep the old account until restarted. Turning it on asks once in a dialog; if you tick it here or edit settings.json, the sidebar shows that dialog once, and No turns it off. Machine-scoped, so Settings Sync never carries it to another machine.

claudeUsage.usageFile.description: Leave empty to use ccswitch's own usage cache. Set to a team snapshot (CtrlA hub usage.json) to show shared seats instead.
